children.value: This document describes the authentication and authorization system for the Platform API. The system uses JWT-based authentication with refresh token rotation.

[!IMPORTANT]
All API endpoints require authentication starting with v2.0. Legacy API keys will be deprecated on January 1, 2027.
The authentication flow involves three primary services:
Auth Service validates credentials against User Store
Auth Service validates the refresh token
New access + refresh tokens are issued

[!WARNING]
Refresh token reuse after rotation indicates a potential token theft. The system will revoke all tokens for the affected user.
Refresh token rotation on every use
Implement certificate pinning for mobile clients
For teams migrating from legacy API keys:
Generate a service account in the admin console
Exchange your API key for OAuth credentials
Update your client to use the new token flow:
The legacy API key system will continue to work in read-only mode until the deprecation date.
Last updated: September 2026 · Author: Platform Engineering Team
